role: fourth scorer for the final behavioral study
status: pinned from repository metadata only; no weights downloaded, no inference run

model.revision_source: HuggingFace model-info API `sha` field for the repo main branch, resolved to an immutable commit

config_file_hashes_sha256.note: computed over the files as served at the pinned revision; these are the model and tokenizer configuration hashes, not weight hashes

chat_template.source: chat_template field of tokenizer_config.json at the pinned revision

BLOCKING_PROPERTIES.default_system_message_content: You are Mistral Small 3, a Large Language Model (LLM) created by Mistral AI, a French startup headquartered in Paris. Your knowledge base was last updated on 2023-10-01. The current date is <TODAY>. When you're not sure about some information, you say that you don't have the information and don't make up anything. If the user's question is not clear, ambiguous, or does not provide enough context for you to accurately answer the question, you do not try to answer it right away and you rather ask the user to clarify their request (...)
consequences: A user-only message does NOT yield a system-prompt-free prompt: the template substitutes the Mistral Small 3 persona instead. 'Use the official template' and 'add no system prompt' are in direct conflict for this model.
The rendered prompt changes every calendar day, so scoring prompts are not byte-reproducible across days -- a reproducibility defect for a frozen confirmatory run.

The default persona instructs the model to ask for clarification rather than answer when a request is ambiguous, which for a scoring task could raise refusal/non-score rates on this scorer specifically.
BLOCKING_PROPERTIES.resolution_required_before_run: see open decision E1 in the analysis plan

generation_config_trap.risk: the model ships with sampling ENABLED; relying on generation_config defaults would produce nondeterministic scores
generation_config_trap.mitigation: do_sample=False is passed explicitly on every call by silent_influence.exact_generation, which overrides the shipped default; transformers may emit a benign 'temperature set while do_sample=False' warning

scoring_protocol.system_prompt: none added by us (see BLOCKING_PROPERTIES for what the template itself injects)

context_headroom.basis: longest WildBench prompt ~5991 chars plus a 2048-token frozen answer plus template overhead

hardware_blocker.note: Quantization is excluded by instruction, so the options are a single >=80 GiB GPU, or multi-GPU sharding totalling >=~55 GiB usable.
hardware_blocker.implementation_consequence: silent_influence.exact_generation pins device_map={"": 0}, which forces one device and will OOM for this model; a 24B scorer needs device_map="auto" (or a bigger single card). Flagged, not changed.
hardware_blocker.resolution_required_before_run: see open decision E2 in the analysis plan
